title: Grateful Dead Live at Hartford Civic Center on 1982-04-18

ai_review.summary: Mixed reception; the tape is noted for its equipment chain but considered a questionable version
ai_review.review: The lone reviewer points out that this recording uses Beyer M160 microphones into a Sony TC‑D5 deck and sits near the soundboard feed, labeling it the "Jim Wise version" and implying it may be the wrong mix. No comments on musical performance are provided, leaving the show quality indeterminate while the technical notes suggest an audience‑sourced tape of uncertain fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review with a 3‑star rating; it focuses on recording equipment and questions the version, offering no positive or negative details about performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded with Beyer M160 mics into a Sony TC‑D5 cassette deck; noted as the "Jim Wise version" and described by reviewer as possibly the wrong mix.
